text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A (Factor VIII deficiency). The normal platelet count and PT, combined with an elevated aPTT (60 sec) and your history of prolonged bleeding post-extraction and easy bruising, strongly suggest a Factor VIII deficiency rather than a platelet or von Willebrand disease issue.
